guides.title: How to think like a seller
guides.keywords: sell seller sales think mindset selling
say: Selling is helping someone decide. Find their problem before you talk about your offer.
Ask more than you tell: what is costing them money or time right now?
Sell the result (more booked jobs), not the tool (an automation).

guides.title: Handling objections
guides.keywords: objection expensive price no time think about it later
say: Agree first, then ask: 'What would make it worth it for you?'
Too expensive: compare the price to what the problem costs them each month.
'Let me think about it': ask what exactly they want to think over, and answer that.

guides.title: Think like a freelancer
guides.keywords: freelancer freelance client clients mindset business
say: You run a business of one: every week needs outreach, delivery and follow-up.
Pick one niche and one offer; being known for one thing gets referrals.
Never do free work; offer to show what you found instead.

guides.title: Plan your day
guides.keywords: plan day focus productive time schedule motivation
say: Do the money task first: outreach before learning.
Set three must-dos only. Tick them, then extras.
End the day by writing tomorrow's first task.

guides.title: Simple thinking for work
guides.keywords: philosophy think life stoic meaning failure rejection fear
say: Control what you can: your actions, not their replies.
Rejection is data, not a verdict on you. Count attempts, not feelings.
Small daily steps beat rare big efforts.
